The first game will be a detective game between Emma and Alice that will take place inside a virtual reality machine that does not have a memory-altering function. Both of them enter the game and begin the final challenge. Emma (who kept her memories this time) opens her eyes and finds herself in an old mansion. She drinks some tea while talking to the mansion's butlers and maids, who do not have names, instead they use numbers as a form of identification. After a while, she hears a scream coming from the upper floors and runs towards the place. When she gets there, Emma finds a dead body and a woman passed out near the body. The woman wakes up and seems confused. Upon noticing this, Emma understands almost immediately that she was being used as a scapegoat. When the other people arrive at the place, the woman that Emma found near the body quickly becomes the main suspect for the murder. Ignoring all this, Emma approaches the body and observes the surroundings.
P1: There is a phrase written in blood on the wall of the room. Who's laughing now?
P2: The victim was stabbed 32 times with a sharp object, most likely a knife.
C1: When observing this, it becomes more than clear that the killer in this case has something personal against the victim.
P3: On the victim's chest, a sketch of the image of a snake was drawn with a knife next to a drawing of a broken heart.

C2: In many countries and places, betrayal is mainly symbolized by the image of a snake. The heart and the snake together can symbolize a betrayal in love. Perhaps the killer killed the victim because of a betrayal in love.

C3: Bright Future High School really likes to put subtle clues like these in their events. Bright Future has a high insistence on testing the intellectual abilities of its students, so it makes sense that they would put this clue, which makes it reliable since they don't usually put false evidence in events and they definitely wouldn't make a case impossible to solve.
P4: In the victim's hand is a torn white cloth like those used by the mansion's butlers.
C4: It is highly likely that one of the butlers is the killer, but there is also the possibility that the killer is trying to place the blame on someone else.
P5: Of all the butlers who were present at the scene, the only one who was not wearing a white cloth around his neck was butler number 17.

C5: Butler number 17 was with Emma and the other butlers and maids in the living room when the crime occurred and was there for 1 hour according to the other servants, which makes the idea of ​​him being the killer impossible.
P6: The victim had his head turned to the left and in that direction there was only a regular wall, however the victim's face suggested that he saw something in that direction.
P7: Emma approaches the wall and discovers a secret passage that leads to the mansion's owner's room.
Final conclusion:

The killer must be one of the owners of the mansion since only they could possibly know about the secret passage, someone who suffered a love betrayal in which the victim was involved and someone with knowledge about symbology.

The event would be in virtual reality and a virtual reality machine would be used to temporarily remove the players' memories. After all, it wouldn't be any fun if they already knew that everything that happened there was merely a game and they wouldn't take the situation seriously. The instructor of the death game, ignoring the students’ questions, began to explain the rules.

Each of the students has a tablet in their hands and on this tablet there is a specific function called find cards that will reveal the location of the card (or the player's role) chosen for that specific player and will also reveal which player's card is, the cards represent the roles of the game and there are several of them, the students have a certain amount of time to find their cards and talk to each other, but revealing or talking about the roles to each other is not allowed and will result in death, after all the students have taken their cards (or roles) and the conversation time runs out they will have to go to the voting room, there they will have to decide among themselves who will be eliminated from the game and vote for that person.

The participant card has nothing special, if the person with the sacrifice card receives the majority of votes, everyone will be killed except the user of the sacrifice card. In addition, the user of the sacrifice can choose one person to survive with him if he wishes, but if the sacrifice does not receive the majority of votes, he will die. The person with the savior card can confiscate and throw away the cards of other students, turning them into participants, but he does not know who has the sacrifice card, so he will have to guess by observing the facial expressions of the other players. In addition, there are special cards whose effects will only be mentioned at the end of the game.

The game will have multiple rounds and will only end when there are only 2 players left. After the time for conversation between the students is over, they will go to the voting room where they will debate and discuss to decide who should be eliminated among the students.
